claims.text: Nimbus 2.0 was published on 2026-03-14 and ships with no runtime dependencies.

evidence.snippet: Nimbus 2.0 is available today, and its runtime dependency list is empty by design.

claims.text: Growth is explained mainly by build-time wins rather than by marketing activity.

evidence.snippet: The announcement highlights the zero-dependency design as the core goal.
The release post also reports build times falling by a third in internal testing.

key_findings.finding: Nimbus 2.0 shipped without runtime dependencies and growth is attributed to build-time wins.
